scene: The sparkling violet cloud dissolves, revealing three waiting rooftop transport lines.
picture: Side-scrolling flat rooftop view. Far left sits an idling teal sidecar motorbike. Left of centre, the player in burnt-orange jacket, beanie, and telescope gazes outward. Centre, a glowing night funicular car rests with its doors wide open. Far right, an eight-legged steel bridge crawler waits upon heavy rooftop rails.
shown: a teal sidecar motorbike parked and idling at far left
a glass-domed funicular car resting with doors open at centre
a multi-legged steel bridge crawler perched on rails at far right
